title: Effective Local Digital Marketing in Canada

facts.fact: Crescentek's page lists Alberta service-area cities: Banff, Brooks, Calgary, Edmonton, Fort McMurray, Grande Prairie, Jasper, Lake Louise, Lethbridge, Medicine Hat, Red Deer and Saint Albert.
Crescentek's page lists the same twelve cities under a British Columbia service-area heading as under Alberta.
Crescentek states it offers a complete range of services, from SEO and PPC to email and social media marketing.
facts.quote: we offer a complete range of services—from SEO and PPC to email and social media marketing.

facts.fact: Crescentek's contact form lists ten selectable services: Lead Generation, Website Design, Mobile App, SEO, PPC, Social Media, Content Production, Reputation Management, ASO, and Photography & Videography.
